the-chasm.name: The Chasm
the-chasm.bio: The Chasm came to be in December 1992, in Mexico City. Daniel Corchado left his old band Cenotaph to embark on a dark journey: the procreation of a unique form of obscure and bizarre Metal of Death. Corchado carried with him the inspiration of the ancient masters: Celtic Frost, Slayer, Black Sabbath, Sacrifice, Destruction and the pure essence of traditional heavy metal plus an infusion of more contemporary acts like Carnage, Winter, Autopsy, early Mayhem, and Dismember. Read more on Last.fm

full-of-hell.bio: Full of Hell is a grindcore band formed in 2009 and based in Ocean City, Maryland and central Pennsylvania. Their sound is an amalgam of 90s grindcore/metalcore, sludge metal and noise; in addition, Full of Hell incorporates industrial and power electronics, which is usually interspersed throughout their relentless grinding death, although they have released a handful of power electronics-only recordings. eric-johanson.name: Eric Johanson
eric-johanson.bio:
Eric Johanson is a modern blues artist, who blends the classic elements of the style with more proggy influences. His side projects Cire and Emptyself offered him musical exploration before his solo career, and bits and pieces of his other discographies can be heard in his solo music as well.
